setupInstructions.step1: Set organization.name to the bank or NBFC's legal entity name.
setupInstructions.step2: Review goals — adjust NII target and NPA thresholds for the institution's current book.
setupInstructions.step5: Configure COMPLIANCE_MONITOR with applicable regulatory framework (RBI / SEBI / Basel III).

goals.label: Net Interest Income
goals.notes: Core NII target. Tracked against interest income minus funding costs.

goals.label: Net Interest Margin
goals.notes: NIM = NII / Average earning assets. Leading indicator of profitability.

goals.label: Customer Satisfaction Score
goals.notes: Quarterly CSAT/NPS from retail and corporate banking clients.

goals.label: Loan Approval TAT
goals.notes: Turnaround time from complete application to sanction letter. Lower is better.

goals.label: Compliance Coverage
goals.notes: Percentage of applicable regulatory controls mapped and verified. Sub-98 triggers COMPLIANCE_MONITOR alert.

goals.label: NPA Ratio
goals.notes: Non-performing assets as percentage of gross advances. Target is upper bound — WAANDA tracks to stay below.

policies.name: Comply before execute
policies.description: Any WAANDA action touching a regulated entity must pass COMPLIANCE_MONITOR check before execution.

policies.name: Block record deletion
policies.description: No financial record may be deleted — immutable audit trail required by regulatory mandate.

policies.name: AML flag escalation
policies.description: Any AML alert above threshold must trigger immediate L3 review.

policies.name: Large credit approval
policies.description: Credit sanctions above ₹1 Cr require L3 approval before disbursement.

policies.name: NPA threshold breach notification
policies.description: Notify credit risk team when any account crosses 90-day overdue threshold.

policies.name: PII handling enforcement
policies.description: Any data export containing customer PII must be flagged and requires approval.

agents.role: Credit risk monitor and NPA predictor
Treasury position monitoring and yield optimisation

delivery.name: Loan Origination Flow
delivery.description: Application received → bureau check → credit scoring → WAANDA recommendation → L3 sanction (if >₹1Cr) → disbursement.

delivery.name: NPA Recovery Protocol
delivery.description: 90+ DPD detected → AML_SENTINEL check → legal hold → recovery team briefing → resolution tracking.

delivery.name: KYC Refresh
delivery.description: Annual KYC due → COMPLIANCE_MONITOR flags → customer notification → document collection → verification → sign-off.

delivery.name: Account Closure
delivery.description: Closure request → balance check → regulatory hold check → AML clearance → archival.

finance.name: Regulatory Filing
finance.description: Filing deadline T-7 days → COMPLIANCE_MONITOR assembles data → L3 review → submission → confirmation.

finance.name: Treasury Rebalancing
finance.description: TREASURY_INTELLIGENCE detects yield gap → rebalancing proposal → L3 approval → execution.

finance.name: Provision Calculation
finance.description: Month-end NPA review → CREDIT_RISK_AGENT computes provision requirements → CFO approval → booking.

sales.name: Product Cross-sell
sales.description: ENTERPRISE_COACH identifies opportunity → LOAN_COACH prepares offer → relationship manager briefing → customer outreach.

sales.name: Attrition Prevention
sales.description: Low activity or balance migration detected → WAANDA risk score → retention offer → outcome tracked.

L4.label: Predictive
L4.description: Loan TAT below target, NPA predicted before 90DPD.

L5.label: Adaptive
L5.description: Treasury intelligence and regulatory auto-filing operational.

G1_ContextAssembly.rationale: Financial context must reflect up-to-date portfolio, NPA, and liquidity data.

G2_DecisionQuality.rationale: WAANDA credit/compliance decisions must cite evidence trail before approval.

G3_PlanningAccuracy.rationale: Loan origination plans must complete within TAT within acceptable variance.

G4_ExecutionReliability.rationale: Regulatory filing workflows must complete with zero errors (compliance mandate).

G5_WorkflowCanvas.rationale: Canvas must render all BFSI playbooks correctly.

G6_RealTimeIntelligence.rationale: AML signals must surface within 30s — extended from 60s due to regulatory urgency.

G7_ReleaseGovernance.rationale: Any changes to compliance workflows require RGS sign-off and full audit trail.

G8_OIS.rationale: Minimum OIS of 60/100 before external reporting on platform adoption.

dnaProfile.notes: BFSI institutions are CONSERVATIVE by default — approvalSpeed SLOW, escalationThreshold LOW. WAANDA should expect longer approval cycles and surface evidence prominently. AML and compliance workflows carry the highest priority at all times.

rgsRules: No changes to AML detection thresholds without Compliance Head sign-off.
All regulatory filing workflows must have a human-in-the-loop checkpoint before submission.
NPA thresholds must be reviewed quarterly and updated in dnaProfile.riskTolerance.
Audit retention is 7 years (2555 days) by regulatory mandate — never reduce this value.
WAANDA must not auto-approve any credit sanction above ₹1 Cr — L3 approval is mandatory.
OIS must be computed with G1 ContextAssembly score ≥ 85 — lower scores invalidate the result.
